title: Reports of a fire at the World Trade Center
text: We interrupt our programming for a developing story in New York. Smoke is rising from one of the towers of the World Trade Center. There are early reports of an aircraft striking the building. Details are still emerging. We do not yet have a confirmed account of what happened.

title: South Tower collapses
text: The South Tower of the World Trade Center has collapsed. A vast cloud of dust is spreading through lower Manhattan. We cannot yet give a reliable account of how many people were still inside. This is an unfolding catastrophe.

title: North Tower collapses

title: Rescue efforts continue

title: 7 World Trade Center collapses
